  Filter.Tendsto
    (fun S =>
      ∑' (m : { m // ∀ (v : FinitePlace K), ¬IsUnramified K χ v → m v = 0 }),

          ∏ v ∈ (↑m).support,

        else 0)

      (∑' (m : { m // ∀ (v : FinitePlace K), ¬IsUnramified K χ v → m v = 0 }),
        ∏ v ∈ (↑m).support,

MasulloGRH.normalizedGlobalFiniteIdelicMellin.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  (χ : UnitaryHeckeCharacter K) (s : ℂ) (hs : 1 < s.re) :
  have f := fun a => finiteAdelicTest K χ (↑↑a).2 * ↑(χ.character ↑a) * ↑(arithmeticFiniteIdeleNorm K ↑a) ^ s;
  Integrable f (normalizedFiniteSubgroupHaar K) ∧
    ∫ (a : ↥(finiteIdeleSubgroup K)), f a ∂normalizedFiniteSubgroupHaar K =
        ∑' (n : FinitePlace K →₀ ℤ),
          ∫ (a : ↥(finiteIdeleSubgroup K)) in finiteIdelicShell K n, f a ∂normalizedFiniteSubgroupHaar K ∧
      ∫ (a : ↥(finiteIdeleSubgroup K)), f a ∂normalizedFiniteSubgroupHaar K = finiteHeckeL K χ s

MasulloGRH.normalizedGlobalFiniteIdelicMellin.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  (χ : MasulloGRH.UnitaryHeckeCharacter K) (s : ℂ) (hs : 1 < s.re) :
  have f := fun a =>
    MasulloGRH.finiteAdelicTest K χ (↑↑a).2 * ↑(χ.character ↑a) * ↑(MasulloGRH.arithmeticFiniteIdeleNorm K ↑a) ^ s;
  MeasureTheory.Integrable f (MasulloGRH.normalizedFiniteSubgroupHaar K) ∧
    ∫ (a : ↥(MasulloGRH.finiteIdeleSubgroup K)), f a ∂MasulloGRH.normalizedFiniteSubgroupHaar K =
        ∑' (n : MasulloGRH.FinitePlace K →₀ ℤ),
          ∫ (a : ↥(MasulloGRH.finiteIdeleSubgroup K)) in MasulloGRH.finiteIdelicShell K n,
            f a ∂MasulloGRH.normalizedFiniteSubgroupHaar K ∧
      ∫ (a : ↥(MasulloGRH.finiteIdeleSubgroup K)), f a ∂MasulloGRH.normalizedFiniteSubgroupHaar K =
        MasulloGRH.finiteHeckeL K χ s
